Rule.Name: XboxImage
Rule.Description: imagebld settings used to build the Xbox .xbe.

StringProperty.Name: StackSize
StringProperty.Description: Title thread stack size in bytes. (/stack)

BoolProperty.Name: ImageDebug
BoolProperty.Description: Include the debug directory in the XBE so the debugger can resolve symbols. (/debug)

BoolProperty.Name: NoLogo
BoolProperty.Description: Do not print the imagebld banner. (/nologo)

BoolProperty.Name: LimitMemory
BoolProperty.Description: Run the title as if the console has only 64 MB of RAM. (/limitmem)

BoolProperty.Name: DontModifyHardDisk
BoolProperty.Description: Prevent the title from modifying the retail hard disk layout. (/dontmodifyhd)

BoolProperty.Name: DontMountUtilityDrive
BoolProperty.Description: Do not mount the utility (Z:) drive at launch (/dontmountud). Cannot be combined with Format Utility Drive.

BoolProperty.Name: FormatUtilityDrive
BoolProperty.Description: Format the utility (Z:) drive at launch (/formatud). Cannot be combined with Don't Mount Utility Drive.

EnumProperty.Name: UtilityDriveClusterSize
EnumProperty.Description: Cluster size for the utility drive (/udcluster). Default lets imagebld choose.

StringListProperty.Name: NoPreload
StringListProperty.Description: Section names that should NOT be preloaded at launch (/nopreload). One entry per section.
